name: LOCK IN, GEEK OUT!
source:
As a high-achieving college student, it’s no surprise you end up being asked to tutor one of your fellow classmates. Normally you would rather spend time on your own than with anyone else and, after meeting the student you’re meant to help, you’re only reaffirmed of that preference.

With an upcoming convention and an unfinished cosplay, you’ve got a lot on your plate. But you’ve never had trouble with the classwork, so this should be a walk in the park, right?

[From [url=https://sleepydragonatelier.itch.io/lock-in-geek-out]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名成绩优异的大学学霸，你被拜托去给同班同学补习功课自然不足为奇。平日里比起与人打交道，你更喜欢独来独往；而在见到自己要辅导的那位同学之后，你更是彻底坚定了这一想法。

眼看漫展在即，手头的Cosplay服装还没做完，你早已忙得焦头烂额。不过课业向来难不倒你，这次补习应该也是小菜一碟吧？

[摘自[url=https://sleepydragonatelier.itch.io/lock-in-geek-out]itch.io[/url]]
